title: Internationalisation readiness
description: For user-facing text and formats: externalised messages, no concatenated sentences, locale data for formats, language tags and a pseudo-localisation test.

sources.title: W3C, Internationalization Quick Tips for the Web
Unicode CLDR, Common Locale Data Repository

rules.instruction: Put every user-facing string of the change in the message catalogue, with a note for translators on context and placeholders.
rules.verification: Search the changed code for user-facing literals outside the catalogue and check that each catalogue entry has a translator note.

rules.instruction: Write each message as a full sentence with named placeholders, and use plural and select arguments instead of concatenating fragments.
rules.verification: Read the changed catalogue entries and check that no sentence is assembled from several entries in code.

rules.instruction: Format dates, times, numbers, currencies and lists with the locale data of the platform or library, not with fixed patterns.
rules.verification: Search the change for hard-coded date or number patterns and check that formatting calls take the user's locale.

rules.instruction: Identify locales with BCP 47 language tags and define the fallback when a translation is missing.
rules.verification: Check the locale configuration for the tags and the fallback chain.

rules.instruction: Run the changed screens with a pseudo-localised build that lengthens strings and adds accents, and with a right-to-left locale if one is supported.
rules.verification: Check the screenshots or test results for truncation, hard-coded text and broken layout.
